extra.final_summary: Average flipper length by species (53 rows after cleaning): Adelie = 190.375 mm, Chinstrap = 196.0 mm, Gentoo = 215.3913 mm. Data problems found: 2 exact duplicate rows (rows 9 and 22) — removed via drop_duplicates so each penguin counts once. The columns used by the question were otherwise clean: species had no label variants and flipper_length_mm was fully numeric, with no missing values and all values within the rules-file range [170, 235]. Caveat: the island column contains misspellings ('Dram' → 'Dream', 'Torgerson' → 'Torgersen' in rows 7, 13, 53), but island is not used in this question, so I left it unchanged; body_mass_g has 2 numbers written as text (e.g. '3,600'), also not used here.
